subject: JAX-RTM resourcing after the Finance sync
body: Anders — resourcing summary after your Finance sync. People: Freya 50% (retrieval methodology), Quentin 40% (solver validation), Maren 35% (pipelines/TPU), Leilani 25% (packaging). Budget, recording what you relayed so it's on paper: Idris verbally earmarked the $120k from Q3 discretionary compute budget line B-88 for this project — that's what funds the accelerator time for the retrieval-at-scale runs in July; the formal entry is pending the Q3 books opening. Compute mechanics: forward-simulation validation runs on titan best-effort now; the July scale runs will need either a vulcan slice or a cirrus allocation, and I'll size that ask once Freya's May demo tells us the per-retrieval cost. Storage: satellite-observation staging goes through Corpus, request filed — comfortably ahead of the v2 freeze on 2026-07-10. — Jelena
